summary: Wake own-claim signing and pending signature promotion only for committed changed keys

replay.detail: Subscribe before replaying the durable own-claim cursor and pending ready keys. Startup drains historical signing and pending pages without waiting for another commit.

schema.detail: Add per-origin signature work frontiers, a claim/member-key pending ready queue, transactional capture triggers and an indexed pending retention deadline. Existing pending signatures seed the queue at open.

rules.detail: Writer-key verification, membership admission and thirty-day pending retention remain unchanged.

compatibility.detail: No wire changes. Existing claim signing and promotion APIs retain their result semantics.

downtime.detail: No manual migration or daemon downtime beyond the normal restart.

manual.detail: /v1/performance exposes process-lifetime claim_signatures signing_pages, signing_candidates, promotion_pages, promotion_candidates and commit_wakes. Idle and unrelated metadata commits perform no candidate scans; waiting claims are reconsidered by their changed key rather than a wrapping discovery cursor.

recovery.detail: Committed ready keys survive interruption, claim arrivals requeue their pending signatures, and member-key activation wakes signing. Only actual indexed retention deadlines wake an otherwise idle signer; failed pages retain their existing error recovery.
